issues: Document is an accreditation scope for an interlaboratory comparison testing provider (ФБУ «Томский ЦСМ»), not a standard product-testing lab scope: the table has only 3 columns (№, object subject to comparison testing, determined indicators/parameters) — there is no norm_doc, OKPD2, TN VED, or numeric range/unit column, so those fields are null on every row; 'indicator' values are qualitative parameter names, not measurement ranges. Full-width rows above groups of table rows are lab-address headers (not ТР ТС sections) and were folded into each row's 'object' field in parentheses rather than used as tr_section, per instructions; no ТР ТС section headings appear anywhere in the document, so tr_section is null throughout. Page content was printed sideways (landscape text on a portrait page) though PDF page rotation metadata was 0; pages were re-rendered rotated 270° to read upright. Row 11 lists 14 separate electrical-network parameters, each emitted as its own JSON row (object/address repeated).
